message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Kernel e2e tests

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.kernel }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        kernel: ["5.10", "5.15", "6.1", "6.6", "6.12", "stable", "mainline"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-build-environment

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/go/pkg/mod
            ~/.cache/go-build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      # Download dependencies for the host build.
      - name: Download Go dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Install VM and trigger dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes make qemu-system-x86 iproute2 iputils-ping curl python3
          CGO_ENABLED=0 go install lmb.io/vimto@latest
          echo "$(go env GOPATH)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          sudo chmod 0666 /dev/kvm

      - name: Build test binaries on host
        run: make -j"$(nproc)" all

      # Fail early on image/boot problems instead of consuming the entire job.
      # SIGINT lets vimto stop QEMU and print its buffered boot console.
      - name: Check kernel VM boots
        env:
          KERNEL_IMAGE: ghcr.io/cilium/ci-kernels:${{ matrix.kernel }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=30s 5m \
            vimto -kernel "$KERNEL_IMAGE" exec -- /bin/uname -a < /dev/null 2>&1 | tee kernel-boot.log

      - name: Run e2e tests in VM
        timeout-minutes: 31
        env:
          KERNEL_IMAGE: ghcr.io/cilium/ci-kernels:${{ matrix.kernel }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=30s 30m \
            vimto -kernel "$KERNEL_IMAGE" exec -- /bin/bash scripts/test-kernel.sh < /dev/null 2>&1 | tee kernel-e2e.log

      - name: Upload guest logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kernel-e2e-${{ matrix.kernel }}
          path: |
            kernel-boot.log
            kernel-e2e.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `go mod download` on every matrix job (seven kernels) with no dependency cache, so module and build artifacts are re-fetched/re-built each run. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports caching dependency downloads keyed by the lockfile to reuse them across runs while preserving all required checks. Prerequisites are met: go.mod/go.sum are present, dependency fetching is repeated, and no equivalent cache exists. Contraindications do not apply: the Go module cache is content-addressed/trusted, and no mutable untrusted content is cached. The change is minimal (one cache step before `go mod download`), keeps `contents: read` unchanged, adds no privileged actions, secrets, deployment, or new network access, and preserves the full build/test matrix and artifact uploads.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}

```yaml
name: Kernel e2e tests

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Linux ${{ matrix.kernel }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        kernel: ["5.10", "5.15", "6.1", "6.6", "6.12", "stable", "mainline"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-build-environment
```

```yaml
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/go/pkg/mod
            ~/.cache/go-build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      # Download dependencies for the host build.
      - name: Download Go dependencies
        run: go mod download
```

```yaml
      - name: Install VM and trigger dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes make qemu-system-x86 iproute2 iputils-ping curl python3
          CGO_ENABLED=0 go install lmb.io/vimto@latest
          echo "$(go env GOPATH)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          sudo chmod 0666 /dev/kvm

      - name: Build test binaries on host
        run: make -j"$(nproc)" all

      # Fail early on image/boot problems instead of consuming the entire job.
      # SIGINT lets vimto stop QEMU and print its buffered boot console.
      - name: Check kernel VM boots
        env:
          KERNEL_IMAGE: ghcr.io/cilium/ci-kernels:${{ matrix.kernel }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=30s 5m \
            vimto -kernel "$KERNEL_IMAGE" exec -- /bin/uname -a < /dev/null 2>&1 | tee kernel-boot.log

      - name: Run e2e tests in VM
        timeout-minutes: 31
        env:
          KERNEL_IMAGE: ghcr.io/cilium/ci-kernels:${{ matrix.kernel }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=30s 30m \
            vimto -kernel "$KERNEL_IMAGE" exec -- /bin/bash scripts/test-kernel.sh < /dev/null 2>&1 | tee kernel-e2e.log

      - name: Upload guest logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kernel-e2e-${{ matrix.kernel }}
          path: |
            kernel-boot.log
            kernel-e2e.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
```
